run.command: export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1; mkdir -p out; S=$(( $(printf %s "$RUN_TAG" | cksum | cut -d" " -f1) % 100000 )); A="--lr {lr} --batch_size {batch_size} --num_hidden {num_hidden} --epoch {epoch} --aug_ratio {aug_ratio} --aug_num {aug_num} --ge USVT"; for k in 0; do s=$((S + 10000*k)); for ds in IMDB-BINARY IMDB-MULTI; do for gm in False True; do PYTHONPATH="/work/src${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}" python -u ./src/gmixup.py --data_path . --model GIN --dataset $ds --gmixup $gm --seed $s --log_screen True --lam_range "[{lam_lo},{lam_hi}]" $A > out/${ds}_${gm}_$k.log 2>&1 & done; done; wait; done; bash gf_harness/emit.sh

msg: search config: evidence gate on, rank ledger
knob names: ; spec knobs no assumption names (a fallback round): lam_lo, lam_hi
trace: trace of 4 process(es): roles aug_num=count, batch_size=size, epoch=count, lr=rate, num_hidden=size; 3 literal lead(s); 0 ambiguous sink value(s)
